leads.title: European Court of Human Rights - January 2019 judgment against North Macedonia on legal gender recognition
leads.documents: Documents that requiring transgender people to undergo sex reassignment surgery before gender marker on ID documents can be changed violates human rights / right to private life; deficiencies in gender-change procedure
leads.detail: Cited as January 2019 ECHR ruling; also cited as 17 January finding violation of privacy rights and right to appeal with EUR 9,000 ($9,900) damages to unnamed transgender applicant

leads.title: U.S. Department of State - Country Reports on Human Rights Practices for 2019: North Macedonia
leads.documents: Documents enforcement climate for LGBTQ people: constitutional/law prohibition of SOGI discrimination in housing, employment, nationality, health care, government enforcement claim, societal prejudice, hate speech, police and prosecutor handling, Pride policing, and government failure to implement gender-identity document changes after ECHR ruling
leads.detail: Section quoted at length in article including June 29 first pride parade, attack on activist Bekim Asani, and ECHR implementation failure

leads.title: Law on Prevention of and Protection against Discrimination
leads.documents: Documents explicit legal protection from discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in all areas
leads.detail: Macedonian: Закон за спречување и заштита од дискриминација; Albanian: Ligji për parandalimin dhe mbrojtjen nga diskriminimi; adopted March 2019 with 52 votes in favour and three abstentions, in effect 22 May after signing by President Stevo Pendarovski; re-passed 27 October 2020

leads.title: Constitutional Court of North Macedonia - 14 May 2020 decision
leads.documents: Documents striking down the 2019 anti-discrimination law on procedural grounds, affecting SOGI protections machinery
leads.detail: Cited as 14 May 2020 Constitutional Court annulment on procedural grounds

leads.title: ILGA-Europe Rainbow Map / Annual Review 2024
leads.documents: Documents comparative LGBT rights legislation status for North Macedonia
leads.detail: Cited as North Macedonia ranked 31st out of 48 European countries in 2024 in terms of LGBT rights legislation

leads.title: Criminal Code of North Macedonia - hate speech amendments
leads.documents: Documents inclusion of sexual orientation and gender identity in section regulating hate speech
leads.detail: Cited via 2019 Country Report summary: Amendments specifically list sexual orientation and gender identity

leads.title: Law on Primary Education (July 2019)
leads.documents: Documents introduction of antidiscrimination language related to sexual orientation and gender identity in primary education
leads.detail: Cited as Law on Primary Education adopted in July [2019]

leads.title: Family Law of North Macedonia - marriage definition
leads.documents: Documents non-recognition of same-sex couples; marriage defined as 'a union between a man and a woman'
leads.detail: Cited in Recognition of same-sex relationships section

leads.title: Assembly of North Macedonia - constitutional amendment proceedings on marriage (2013-2015)
leads.documents: Documents attempts to constitutionally define marriage as solely between a man and a woman and to require two-thirds majority to regulate marriage, family and civil unions; voting outcomes
leads.detail: Cited details: September 2013 failure to meet two-thirds; late June 2014 resubmission; January 2015 vote in favour; 9 January committee approval; 20 January approval by 72 votes to 4; final session commenced 26 January but never concluded, in recess until end of 2015

leads.title: Coalition Margini / Coalition Sexual and Health Rights of Marginalized Communities documentation via LGBTI Support Center of Helsinki Committee
leads.documents: Documents incident counts and enforcement gaps: 70 cases of violence against LGBTI individuals, five cases of discrimination, verbal assault by police officer, school attack resulting in broken nose, under-reporting, Skopje prosecutor ineffectiveness on hate speech, and June 29 2019 attack on activist Bekim Asani
leads.detail: Cited as CSO Coalition Margini data for the year in Country Reports section; LGBTI Support Center described as subsidiary of Helsinki Committee for Human Rights of the Republic of Macedonia in Skopje providing legal aid and advocacy
